section_path: Other and Unspecified Major Salivary Glands
text:
C081  Sublingual gland
C088  Overlapping lesion of major salivary glands
C089  Major salivary gland, NOS

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Major Salivary Glands,* pages 54-57.
* Primary sites C088 and C089 are listed in the chapter heading but are not specified in the anatomic subsites in this chapter of the UICC manual; however, they are included in this schema and TNM staged if appropriate histology criteria are met

**Note 2:**  Laterality must be coded for C081.

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Parotid Gland, Other Major Salivary Glands* chapter on page 54 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=54).
